title.hi: App ke andar sign in kijiye

description.en: Sign in to Sales X-Ray with Continue with Google, right inside the app, then join your team's workspace. If your leads are in another workspace, Switch takes you there.
description.hi: App ke andar hi Continue with Google se Sales X-Ray mein sign in kijiye, phir apni team ka workspace join kijiye. Leads doosre workspace mein hain? Switch aapko wahan le jaata hai.
description.mr: App madhyech Continue with Google ne Sales X-Ray madhye sign in kara, mag tumchya team cha workspace join kara. Leads dusrya workspace madhye aahet? Switch tumhala tithe neto.

say.en: Signing in to Sales X-Ray, right inside the app, and landing in your team's workspace.
say.hi: App के अंदर ही Sales X-Ray में sign in करना, और सीधे अपनी team के workspace में पहुँचना.
say.mr: App मध्येच Sales X-Ray मध्ये sign in करणं, आणि थेट तुमच्या team च्या workspace मध्ये पोहोचणं.

latn.hi: App ke andar hi Sales X-Ray mein sign in karna, aur seedhe apni team ke workspace mein pahunchna.
latn.mr: App madhyech Sales X-Ray madhye sign in karna, aani thet tumchya team chya workspace madhye pohochna.

say.en: Next: your first steps in the app.
say.hi: अगले video में: app में आपके पहले steps.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: app मधले तुमचे पहिले steps.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: app mein aapke pehle steps.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: app madhle tumche pahile steps.

text.en: Sign in with Google, no browser
text.hi: Google se sign in, bina browser
text.mr: Google ne sign in, browser shivay

say.en: Signing in to Sales X-Ray takes three taps. Watch.
say.hi: Sales X-Ray में sign in, बस तीन taps. देखिए.
say.mr: Sales X-Ray मध्ये sign in, फक्त तीन taps. बघा.

latn.hi: Sales X-Ray mein sign in, bas teen taps. Dekhiye.
latn.mr: Sales X-Ray madhye sign in, fakta teen taps. Bagha.

say.en: Open Sales X-Ray. On the sign-in screen, use Continue with Google.
say.hi: Sales X-Ray खोलिए. Sign-in screen पे Continue with Google चुनिए.
say.mr: Sales X-Ray उघडा. Sign-in screen वर Continue with Google निवडा.

latn.hi: Sales X-Ray kholiye. Sign-in screen pe Continue with Google chuniye.
latn.mr: Sales X-Ray ughda. Sign-in screen var Continue with Google nivda.

say.en: First tick the box, to confirm you're eighteen or older and accept the terms. If you forget, the box reminds you.
say.hi: पहले box पे tick कीजिए, ये confirm करने के लिए कि आप अठारह साल या उससे बड़े हैं और terms मानते हैं. भूल गए, तो box खुद याद दिलाता है.
say.mr: आधी box वर tick करा, हे confirm करायला की तुम्ही अठरा वर्षांचे किंवा मोठे आहात आणि terms मान्य आहेत. विसरलात, तर box स्वतः आठवण करून देतो.

latn.hi: Pehle box pe tick kijiye, yeh confirm karne ke liye ki aap athaarah saal ya usse bade hain aur terms maante hain. Bhool gaye, toh box khud yaad dilata hai.
latn.mr: Aadhi box var tick kara, he confirm karayla ki tumhi athra varshanche kinva mothe aahat aani terms manya aahet. Visarlat, tar box swatah aathvan karun deto.

say.en: Then tap Continue with Google. In the app, Google's own sheet slides up with the accounts on your phone. No browser.
say.hi: फिर Continue with Google दबाइए. App में Google की अपनी sheet नीचे से आती है, आपके phone के accounts के साथ. कोई browser नहीं.
say.mr: मग Continue with Google दाबा. App मध्ये Google ची स्वतःची sheet खालून येते, तुमच्या phone वरच्या accounts सकट. Browser नाही.

latn.hi: Phir Continue with Google dabaiye. App mein Google ki apni sheet neeche se aati hai, aapke phone ke accounts ke saath. Koi browser nahi.
latn.mr: Mag Continue with Google daba. App madhye Google chi swatahchi sheet khalun yete, tumchya phone varchya accounts sakat. Browser nahi.

say.en: Pick your work account, and you're straight back in Sales X-Ray.
say.hi: अपना work account चुनिए, और आप सीधे Sales X-Ray में वापस.
say.mr: तुमचा work account निवडा, आणि तुम्ही थेट Sales X-Ray मध्ये परत.

latn.hi: Apna work account chuniye, aur aap seedhe Sales X-Ray mein wapas.
latn.mr: Tumcha work account nivda, aani tumhi thet Sales X-Ray madhye parat.

say.en: If your company invited you, choose Join. You land in your team's workspace, with your leads and calls.
say.hi: अगर आपकी company ने invite किया है, तो Join चुनिए. आप सीधे अपनी team के workspace में, अपने leads और calls के साथ.
say.mr: तुमच्या company ने invite केलं असेल, तर Join निवडा. तुम्ही थेट तुमच्या team च्या workspace मध्ये, तुमच्या leads आणि calls सकट.

latn.hi: Agar aapki company ne invite kiya hai, toh Join chuniye. Aap seedhe apni team ke workspace mein, apne leads aur calls ke saath.
latn.mr: Tumchya company ne invite kela asel, tar Join nivda. Tumhi thet tumchya team chya workspace madhye, tumchya leads aani calls sakat.

say.en: Already signed in? Tap your workspace name at the top. Your company's invitation waits under Invitations.
say.hi: पहले से sign in हैं? ऊपर अपने workspace के नाम पे tap कीजिए. आपकी company का invitation, Invitations में मिलेगा.
say.mr: आधीच sign in केलंय? वर तुमच्या workspace च्या नावावर tap करा. तुमच्या company चं invitation, Invitations मध्ये दिसेल.

latn.hi: Pehle se sign in hain? Upar apne workspace ke naam pe tap kijiye. Aapki company ka invitation, Invitations mein milega.
latn.mr: Aadhich sign in kelay? Var tumchya workspace chya naavavar tap kara. Tumchya company cha invitation, Invitations madhye disel.

say.en: Tap Join. In a moment you're in your company's workspace, and its name shows at the top.
say.hi: Join दबाइए. पल भर में आप अपनी company के workspace में होंगे, और ऊपर उसका नाम दिखेगा.
say.mr: Join दाबा. क्षणात तुम्ही तुमच्या company च्या workspace मध्ये असाल, आणि वर तिचं नाव दिसेल.

latn.hi: Join dabaiye. Pal bhar mein aap apni company ke workspace mein honge, aur upar uska naam dikhega.
latn.mr: Join daba. Kshanaat tumhi tumchya company chya workspace madhye asal, aani var tiche naav disel.

say.en: If you ever open a workspace without your leads, a card tells you where they are. Tap Switch, and you're there.
say.hi: अगर कभी ऐसा workspace खुले जिसमें आपके leads नहीं हैं, तो एक card बताता है कि वो कहाँ हैं. Switch दबाइए, और आप वहाँ पहुँच गए.
say.mr: कधी असा workspace उघडला ज्यात तुमचे leads नाहीत, तर एक card सांगतो ते कुठे आहेत. Switch दाबा, आणि तुम्ही तिथे पोहोचलात.

latn.hi: Agar kabhi aisa workspace khule jismein aapke leads nahi hain, toh ek card batata hai ki woh kahan hain. Switch dabaiye, aur aap wahan pahunch gaye.
latn.mr: Kadhi asa workspace ughdla jyat tumche leads nahit, tar ek card sangto te kuthe aahet. Switch daba, aani tumhi tithe pohochlat.
